description: Default capabilities for the Forge main window - generic property/tree commands only, no editor-specific permissions (architecture.md §6). Window-control permissions below (minimize/maximize/close/drag) back the custom TitleBar in chrome/TitleBar.tsx, needed because tauri.conf.json now sets "decorations": false (P6 theming - see p6-theming-notes.md) and core:window:default alone does not grant them.
